question: The United Nations (UN) observes ______ as the International Day of Clean Air for blue skies.
solution:
The correct answer is __**7 September.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• The **International Day of Clean Air for blue skies** is observed globally on September 07 to promote and facilitate actions to improve air quality.
 
• The very first International Day of Clean Air for blue skies was held on September 7th, 2020__.
 
• The Day aims to raise public awareness at all levels that clean air is important for health, productivity, the economy and the environment.
 
• The UN General Assembly adopted the resolution to hold an International Day of Clean Air for blue skies on December 19, 2019, during its 74th session.
